reuse.why: Uses the existing link.assertAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the link body and the download function are new copies of the per-provider ones.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount repeats the upgrade-or-create/payee/sync/notify body of the five other link functions, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a compacted copy of downloadEnableBankingTransactions.

placement.why: Handler, download and server URL follow the tree's layout, but SyncServerFintegraAccount is declared inside types/models/akahu.ts instead of its own model file like every other provider.

maintainability.why: Readable and consistent with the per-provider convention, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow and another download copy, and hides the Fintegra type in the Akahu module.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The shared guard and bank/sync helpers are used; the tree has no shared link-body helper to go around.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies are compacted (one-line objects) but plainly the same code, not disguised.
